en.headline: Hong Kong stock market closed today for Chung Yeung Festival holiday
en.dek: Trading on the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing is suspended for the full day as the general holiday falls on the Monday after the festival.
body: The Hong Kong stock market is closed today for the Chung Yeung Festival holiday.
Because the Double Ninth Festival fell on Sunday, the following Monday is observed as a general holiday, and the Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has suspended trading for the full day.
RTHK reported the market closure this morning. Trading is expected to resume on Tuesday.

zh.headline: 港股今日重陽節假期休市一天
zh.dek: 重陽節逢周日，翌日周一為公眾假期，港交所全日暫停交易，預計周二恢復。
body: 港股今日因重陽節假期全日休市。
由於重陽節今年落在周日，翌日周一列為公眾假期，香港交易所暫停全日交易。
港台今日早上報道休市消息。交易預計於周二恢復。
